title: GLM-5.3: Frontier coding with emergent cyber capabilities
titleZh: GLM-5.3：具有新兴网络能力的前沿编码
author: pella
relevanceReason: 命中 1 个 AI/科技关键词。

comments.author: leobuskin
comments.textRawHtml:
I bought $18 GLM official subscription yesterday (5.2, but new model version was already leaking on some docs), set it up with Claude Code harness... and I’ve bumped to $80 plan almost immediately. It’s the first model that agreed on a proper security research (red team scenario), executed it seamlessly, including 0-days in WP plugins, RCE, 6.8 kernel exploit adaptation, etc - while playing against another GLM agent as a defender (following HF story)!

I understand that such models can be used by malicious actors, but it’s fair to have it publicly available (and play on your side in case of emergency). This is what changes the world in a better way, I think, not the guardrails.
comments.textZhHtml:
我昨天购买了 18 美元的 GLM 官方订阅（5.2，但新模型版本已经在一些文档中泄露），用 Claude Code 工具进行设置......我几乎立即就升级到了 80 美元的计划。这是第一个就适当的安全研究达成一致的模型（红队场景），无缝执行，包括 WP 插件中的 0 天、RCE、6.8 内核漏洞利用适应等 - 同时与另一个 GLM 代理作为防御者对抗（以下 HF 故事）！

我知道此类模型可能会被恶意行为者使用，但将其公开是公平的（并在紧急情况下为您提供支持）。我认为，这才是以更好的方式改变世界的因素，而不是护栏。

children.author: weego
children.textRawHtml: what is a harness? The comments below are mixing IDE/ADE but other suggestions are purely terminal things and I don't get what their value is over just a terminal. Is a harness like a loop where it's just a vague thing that everyone nods about but everyone is nodding at something different?
children.textZhHtml: 什么是安全带？下面的评论混合了 IDE/ADE，但其他建议纯粹是终端的东西，我不明白它们在终端上的价值是什么。安全带是否像一个循环，它只是一个模糊的东西，每个人都点头，但每个人都在点头不同的东西？

children.author: computerex
children.textRawHtml: The harness is the agent. LLM's can be asked to output things in JSON for example. The LLM then literally asks for things like "execute this cmd" or search/replace this string. The LLM outputs text, but in a deterministic format that can be parsed. The harness calls the LLM, exposes tools, executes tools the LLM asks for, gates tool use based on security controls. It's the runtime that the agent uses to do work.
children.textZhHtml: 安全带是代理。例如，法学硕士可能会被要求输出 JSON 中的内容。然后，LLM 从字面上要求诸如“执行此命令”或搜索/替换此字符串之类的内容。 LLM 输出文本，但采用可解析的确定性格式。该工具调用 LLM、公开工具、执行 LLM 要求的工具、基于安全控制来控制工具的使用。它是代理用来完成工作的运行时。

children.author: stogot
children.textRawHtml: Are the LLM and agent the same thing? Why different nouns ?
children.textZhHtml: LLM和代理是一回事吗？为什么有不同的名词？

children.author: rl1987
children.textRawHtml: LLM is the digital brain. Agent is a software robot with "sensors" (tooling to read data from files/web) and "actuators" (tooling to perform changes in the environment) that is based on the digital brain.
children.textZhHtml: LLM 是数字大脑。 Agent 是一个软件机器人，具有基于数字大脑的“传感器”（从文件/网络读取数据的工具）和“执行器”（执行环境变化的工具）。

children.author: computerex
children.textRawHtml: The LLM is the core model, but the harness has the prompts/tool definitions, guidance/recovery/correction code. The harness itself is the agent, because same model may perform vastly differently on different harnesses. Agent is the system working as a whole, harness+llm.
children.textZhHtml: LLM是核心模型，但线束具有提示/工具定义、指导/恢复/纠正代码。线束本身就是代理，因为相同的模型在不同的线束上可能表现截然不同。 Agent是一个整体工作的系统，harness+llm。

children.author: jewel
children.textRawHtml:
My understanding is that the harness is the set of function calls (or tool calls) that let the LLM interact with your codebase. It's independent of the IDE or CLI.

The tool calls will be, among other things, something like ReadFile, RipGrep, PatchFile, Shell.

When people talk about the value of different harnesses, they're also implicitly talking about the quality of the system prompt.

The same exact model, when given a different set of tools and a different system prompt, can behave differently.
children.textZhHtml:
我的理解是，工具是一组函数调用（或工具调用），让 LLM 与您的代码库进行交互。 它独立于 IDE 或 CLI。

工具调用将包括 ReadFile、RipGrep、PatchFile、Shell 等。

当人们谈论不同工具的价值时，他们也在隐含地谈论系统提示的质量。

同一个模型，当提供不同的工具集和不同的系统提示时，可能会表现出不同的行为。

children.author: kristjansson
children.textRawHtml: harnesss == thing that calls LLM API, acts on response, and maybe does that again.
children.textZhHtml: harnesss == 调用 LLM API 的东西，对响应起作用，并且可能会再次执行此操作。

children.author: LoganDark
children.textRawHtml: A harness is the tooling around an LLM that uses its responses to do work. For example, let's say a harness sends your message to the LLM and the LLM emits a tool call - the harness is responsible for processing that tool call, executing the tool, and then sending its response back to the LLM to get more of its turn. The harness is responsible for keeping the conversation history to send back to the LLM each time it needs more completion. The harness is responsible for displaying the user interface that allows you to send instructions to the LLM or configure MCP servers or whatever. Claude Code is a harness, Pi is a harness, OpenCode is (technically) a harness, it's basically the LLM "client". The model is what generates the completions itself, but the harness is how you invoke it. And generally when people say "agent" they mean the harness hooked up to some model.
children.textZhHtml: harness 是围绕 LLM 的工具，它使用其响应来完成工作。例如，假设一个线束将您的消息发送到 LLM，而 LLM 发出一个工具调用 - 该线束负责处理该工具调用、执行该工具，然后将其响应发送回 LLM 以获取更多信息。该工具负责保存对话历史记录，以便在每次需要更多完成时发送回 LLM。该线束负责显示用户界面，允许您向 LLM 发送指令或配置 MCP 服务器或其他内容。 Claude Code 是一个工具，Pi 是一个工具，OpenCode（技术上）是一个工具，它基本上是 LLM“客户端”。模型本身生成补全，而线束则是调用它的方式。一般来说，当人们说“代理”时，他们指的是连接到某个模型的安全带。

children.author: Garpagan
children.textRawHtml: Harness is a set of artisanal prompts.

children.author: RussianCow
children.textRawHtml: You might be joking, but a harness provides much more than just the prompts: at a minimum, it provides the system prompt and the built-in tools that the LLM can use, but it can also provide things like subagent management, custom compaction logic, session forking, etc.
children.textZhHtml: 你可能在开玩笑，但是harness提供的不仅仅是提示：它至少提供了LLM可以使用的系统提示和内置工具，但它还可以提供诸如子代理管理、自定义压缩逻辑、会话分叉等功能。

children.author: tchalla
children.textRawHtml: It’s a new buzzword where everyone says it but means entirely different things. You can use it to sound smart whenever there’s a conversation about how you’re not extracting value from your coding agent and also when you are extracting really good value. Very flexible term!
children.textZhHtml: 这是一个新的流行词，每个人都这么说，但含义却完全不同。每当有人谈论你如何没有从编码代理中获取价值以及当你正在获取真正好的价值时，你都可以使用它来听起来很聪明。非常灵活的术语！
